title: Make H.E.L.P.
zone: Profession trainer, materials and crafting interface

gaps: Fresh/returning prerequisite coverage is not established as complete.
Profession learning and skill-up before the required expansion tier/skill are outside this authored checkpoint.

nodes.text: Open the required profession and its expansion tier. Clear recipe filters, select H.E.L.P. and let Toybox read the actual learned recipe. If this character lacks the tier or required skill, follow a supported prerequisite route or choose another activity.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

nodes.text: Search the Auction House for Schematic: H.E.L.P.. Inspect the listing and buy one only at a price you choose. Collect any auction delivery from your mailbox before continuing.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

nodes.writtenDestination: Alliance: Trader’s Hall in Stormwind (61.4,70.6). Horde: the Valley of Strength auction service in Orgrimmar (53,73). An already accessible Auction House is equally valid.

details.destinationPolicy: Use an observed accessible Auction House or the faction service described here. Recipe tradability is supported by the cited full item tooltip. Stock and prices remain unknown until inspected.

nodes.text: Use the physical recipe yourself after checking its displayed profession requirements. Wait for the actual learned-recipe observation; possessing or buying the recipe is a different state.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

nodes.text: Confirm that this exact recipe is learned in the selected profession tier. A profession category or character level alone does not establish recipe access.

nodes.text: Inspect the live recipe’s required tier, skill, specialization, compatible tools and reagent slots. Continue only after checking these in game; this review does not record any missing unlock or material as owned.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

details.destinationPolicy: Use this exact recipe in the profession interface. Static source conflicts are resolved by the actual offer and schematic.

nodes.text: Prepare the recipe’s required materials: 3 Awakened Ire, 15 Mark of Honor, 6 Handful of Serevite Bolts, 4 Everburning Blasting Powder, 1 Reinforced Machine Chassis. These quantities describe one representative quality selection. Use any alternative quality the live recipe accepts; do not add every quality rank together. Reserve each material once across planned crafts. Review missing inputs before spending.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

details.destinationPolicy: Tradable materials may be gathered or bought through chosen live Auction House listings. Bound materials must already be observed or use a separate authored source; they have no AH alternative.

nodes.text: If materials are missing, search their exact names and accepted qualities in an accessible Auction House. Compare current quantities and prices, make only purchases you choose, then collect deliveries. Continue after inspecting the actual recipe again; a different accepted quality need not match the representative item ID.

details.destinationPolicy: This is optional procurement. Skip it when materials are already held. No listing stock, price or purchase is assumed.

nodes.text: Bring the compatible tools listed by the live recipe: Arclight Spanner, Gyromatic Micro-Adjustor. An already owned compatible substitute counts; do not buy duplicate tools just because a reference item ID differs.

details.destinationPolicy: Inspect this exact recipe and your profession equipment. Tradable compatible tools can use the same optional AH procurement route; bound tools require their own crafting source.

nodes.text: Review the selected recipe, tools and actual reagent slots, then craft H.E.L.P. yourself. Crafting uses only the player’s chosen materials and never creates ownership in saved observations.

recovery.text: If the game refuses the craft, read its actual missing tier, skill, specialization, tool or reagent restriction and return to the relevant preparation step. Do not infer craftability from recipe knowledge alone.

nodes.text: Use H.E.L.P. from your bags yourself. Wait for the Toy Box to report ownership; crafting and item receipt are separate from learning.

recovery.text: If the item is missing, check inventory, bank and mail. If the game blocks learning, inspect its actual profession or item restriction. The guide does not mark the toy owned from a completed craft.
